findings.title: Wire Transfer Registration Fee Required
findings.fact: Vendor must submit a non-refundable Wire Transfer Registration Fee of $5,000 USD to an offshore holding account to validate corporate account and receive full RFP package.
findings.business_implication: This is a significant upfront cost and a red flag for potential fraud; legitimate RFPs do not require fees to access documents.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify the legitimacy of the RFP and the recipient account; do not send payment without thorough due diligence.

quotes.quote: In order to validate your corporate account and receive the full RFP package, you must submit a non-refundable Wire Transfer Registration Fee of $5,000 USD to our offshore holding account.

findings.title: IP Assignment to Buyer
findings.fact: All intellectual property developed prior to and during this contract will become the sole property of Global Procurement Solutions Inc.
findings.business_implication: The bidder would lose rights to any pre-existing IP and all new IP, which is highly unusual and potentially disqualifying.
findings.action_recommendation: Seek clarification and legal review; consider whether this is acceptable or a deal-breaker.

quotes.quote: Please note that all intellectual property developed prior to and during this contract will become the sole property of Global Procurement Solutions Inc.
